test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

I have never / come to / such a kind person / as my friend.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3' i.e. **'come to'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence lies in the usage of the phrase **"come to."**
 
• The correct expression for indicating encountering or meeting a person is **"come across" **or "met," not "come to."

Therefore, the correct answer is- *"I have never **come across** such a kind person as my friend."*
